title: [DOC-2] RelayTombstone uses JSON-LD `@context` and a signature embedded in the body
description: Review finding DOC-2: RelayTombstone uses JSON-LD `@context` and a signature embedded in the body (lens DOC). Location: guides/relay-operator.md:2206-2220; spec/13-encoding.md:18, :51. Fix: As proposed. spec/13-encoding.md:51 says "A signature is never embedded in the `body` it signs." Use a typed envelope with an operator- or practice-owned type URI (following compliance-chain-witness.md:26-27), `contentType` `application/json`, the body fields listed in DOC.md, and `sig` in the envelope per §13.1.1. Agora has no JSON-LD (decision agora-d1-envelope). Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
